title: Study of Histological Samples From Patients With Hereditary Haemorrhagic Telangiectasia
brief_summary: In this study the investigators will obtain histological samples from people with hereditary haemorrhagic telangiectasia (HHT, also known as Osler-Weber-Rendu Syndrome).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with Hereditary Haemorrhagic Telangiectasia

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to provide informed consent
